scope: Five guide topics reconstructed in Japanese and Korean; five vehicle bodies retained without rewriting. All 20 bodies mechanically compared to frozen EN; vehicle numeric differences and critical recovered scope/date points checked.

reconstruction.basis: Fresh full translation against current frozen EN, using surviving task context for fact boundaries.

method: Guide page-by-page paragraph alignment, table/FAQ review, source and internal link multiset comparison, numeric comparison with written-month normalization, and semantic checks of each flagged number. Image labels/alt/captions reconciled to frozen English SEO.

odometer-service-history-reconciliation: All paragraphs, five evidence rows and four FAQ answers translated.
Discrepancy is not a fraud conclusion; original units/dates retained.
UK MOT correction evidence and Northern Ireland separate route preserved; US NMVTIS coverage does not become global.
Current display, lifetime distance, service date and document issue date remain distinct.
flood-damage-evidence-used-car-purchase: All paragraphs, six evidence rows and four FAQ answers translated.
Insurance total loss is not automatically flood damage; absent branding is not clearance.
Observations and inferred flood cause kept separate; inspection limitations remain explicit.
High-voltage flood concern retains no charging/driving experiment and qualified safety advice.
srs-airbag-repair-evidence: All paragraphs, six evidence rows and four FAQ answers translated.
No DIY dismantling/probing; deployment, provenance and qualified inspection are distinct.
An extinguished lamp does not prove authenticity; estimate does not prove completed work.
Ford Australia scope and European Model 3 persistent-warning immediate service/no-driving instruction preserved.
towbar-trailer-rating-evidence: All paragraphs, seven evidence rows and four FAQ answers translated.
Vehicle, train, axle, braked/unbraked, vertical coupling and hardware limits remain separate.
UK exception for cars first used before 1 August 1998 retained; UK/Great Britain/NSW/US/Volvo UK scopes explicit.
Later towbar installation may need Volvo system update, not all vehicles require coding.
diesel-dpf-scr-maintenance-evidence: All paragraphs, six evidence rows and five FAQ answers translated.
Soot regeneration and ash removal are distinct; Korean uses 회분 제거.
No universal pressure threshold, regeneration procedure, cleaning interval or import permission inferred.
CARB/EPA historical technical context and Cummins/Volvo application boundaries preserved.
DEF particle/chemical contamination distinction and professional assessment retained.

numeric_exceptions_reviewed.nio-et5:ko: One fewer model digit 5: The ET5’s dimensions becomes 치수 in ET5 context. Added 0, 1, 3 translate zero, an entire year, three-year warranty.

numeric_exceptions_reviewed.smart-1:ko: Added 2 twice translates second row; added 3 translates three-phase.
